Guidance & outlook: The bank sanctioned more than INR95,500 crores of credit facilities during first quarter of FY2026-27and total of INR1.38 lakh crores is pending for disbursement.
Our PCR stands at 97.23% as on 30th J une 2026, which is well above our guidance of more than 96% for financial year 2027.
Our guidance for slippages ratio was to remain below 0.9% in FY 2027 and we are well within our guidance level as slippages ratio for this year is 0.68%.
Growth & demand: Our gross global business reached to INR29.98 lakh crores, making a healthy 10.2% Y-o-Y growth.
Our advances grew by 12.7% Y-o-Y to INR12.73 lakh crores despite a INR22,411 crores low - yielding IBPC exposure reduction, largely from the retail portfolio.
Excluding the impact of the IBPC book, core advances recorded a strong 15.4% Y-o-Y growth, underscoring sustained credit demand and healthy business momentum.
Margins & costs: Operating profits for the Q1 of this year is INR7,519 crores as against the INR7,081 crores of Q1 of last year, witnessing a growth rate of 6.2%.
